spec: FR-01 / FR-04 / §14 / §21 — the seeded templates: every TEMPLATE event (the ten sendable + optout_confirmation) in both launch languages, REAL Ethiopic never lorem, each body using only its event's allowed variables (FR-04). The §21 four (ticket_created, ticket_resolved, window_reengagement, offline_form_confirmation) are ON by the settings seed; the rest are templates only, off. quiet_hours_policy: exempt for verification_code / security_notification (FR-04) and for optout_confirmation (it answers the STOP just sent); hold otherwise. Every string synthetic; every Amharic body machine-authored → the R-14 queue.

entries.name: Ticket created
entries.body: {{brand.name}}: we received your request. Ticket {{ticket.number}} is open and an agent will be with you shortly.

entries.name: ትኬት ተከፍቷል
entries.body: {{brand.name}}፦ ጥያቄዎን ተቀብለናል። ትኬት {{ticket.number}} ተከፍቷል፤ ወኪል በቅርቡ ያገኝዎታል።

entries.name: Agent assigned
entries.body: {{brand.name}}: an agent now has your case, ticket {{ticket.number}}.

entries.name: ወኪል ተመድቧል
entries.body: {{brand.name}}፦ ትኬት {{ticket.number}} ለወኪል ተመድቧል።

entries.name: Reply waiting
entries.body: {{brand.name}}: there is a new reply on ticket {{ticket.number}}. Please check your support chat.

entries.name: መልስ ይጠብቅዎታል
entries.body: {{brand.name}}፦ በትኬት {{ticket.number}} ላይ አዲስ መልስ አለ። እባክዎ የድጋፍ ውይይትዎን ይመልከቱ።

entries.name: Ticket resolved
entries.body: {{brand.name}}: ticket {{ticket.number}} is resolved. Thank you, {{customer.name}}. Reply STOP to opt out.

entries.name: ትኬት ተፈትቷል
entries.body: {{brand.name}}፦ ትኬት {{ticket.number}} ተፈትቷል። እናመሰግናለን {{customer.name}}። ለማቆም ተወው ብለው ይላኩ።

entries.name: Ticket closed
entries.body: {{brand.name}}: ticket {{ticket.number}} is now closed. Write to us again any time.

entries.name: ትኬት ተዘግቷል
entries.body: {{brand.name}}፦ ትኬት {{ticket.number}} ተዘግቷል። በማንኛውም ጊዜ እንደገና ይጻፉልን።

entries.name: Security notice
entries.body: {{brand.name}} security: there was a change on your staff account. If this was not you, sign in and review your sessions.

entries.name: የደህንነት ማሳወቂያ
entries.body: {{brand.name}} ደህንነት፦ በሠራተኛ መለያዎ ላይ ለውጥ ተደርጓል። እርስዎ ካልሆኑ ይግቡና ክፍለ ጊዜዎችዎን ይመልከቱ።

entries.name: Verification code
entries.body: {{brand.name}}: your code is {{code}}. It expires in 10 minutes. Never share it.

entries.name: የማረጋገጫ ኮድ
entries.body: {{brand.name}}፦ ኮድዎ {{code}} ነው። በ10 ደቂቃ ውስጥ ያበቃል። ለማንም አያጋሩት።

entries.name: Service announcement
entries.body: {{brand.name}}: scheduled maintenance tonight from 01:00 to 03:00. Support stays reachable by phone.

entries.name: የአገልግሎት ማስታወቂያ
entries.body: {{brand.name}}፦ ዛሬ ማታ ከ01:00 እስከ 03:00 የታቀደ ጥገና አለ። ድጋፍ በስልክ ይቀጥላል።

entries.name: Reply-window re-engagement
entries.body: {{brand.name}}: we could not reach you on Telegram about ticket {{ticket.number}}. Please write to us there so we can continue.

entries.name: የመልስ መስኮት ዳግም-ተሳትፎ
entries.body: {{brand.name}}፦ ስለ ትኬት {{ticket.number}} በቴሌግራም ልናገኝዎ አልቻልንም። እንድንቀጥል እባክዎ እዚያ ይጻፉልን።

entries.name: Offline form received
entries.body: {{brand.name}}: we got your message. Ticket {{ticket.number}} is open and we will text you the moment someone starts on it.

entries.name: ከመስመር ውጭ ቅጽ ተቀብለናል
entries.body: {{brand.name}}፦ መልእክትዎን ተቀብለናል። ትኬት {{ticket.number}} ተከፍቷል፤ ሰው እንደጀመረ ወዲያው እንጽፍልዎታለን።

entries.name: Opt-out confirmed
entries.body: {{brand.name}}: you will not receive further SMS from us. This is the last one.

entries.name: መውጣት ተረጋግጧል
entries.body: {{brand.name}}፦ ከእኛ ተጨማሪ SMS አይደርስዎትም። ይህ የመጨረሻው ነው።
